x: In 1958, Middlesex 3, he ran a courageous 2nd to the powerful Frank Seal and the following year in the same event he was beaten into 3rd place by Nat Fisher and Peter Miller.
His time of 31:39.0, 30 seconds behind Nat Fisher, placed him at the top of his age group. Other Bels to compete were Gerry North 5th in 32:06.8, and Charlie Walker, 23rd in 35:27.0.
